techniques.name: Port Scanning
techniques.description: Rapid connection attempts across multiple ports from a single source indicating reconnaissance.
defense_recommendations: Rate-limit inbound connection attempts per source IP
Deploy honeypot ports to detect and tarpit scanners
Alert SOC when unique ports scanned exceeds threshold in 60s window

techniques.name: DNS Tunneling
techniques.description: Abnormal DNS query patterns used to exfiltrate data or establish covert C2 channels.
defense_recommendations: Monitor DNS query length and entropy
Block known DGA and tunneling domains
Deploy DNS sinkhole for suspicious TLDs

techniques.name: Suspicious Process Execution
techniques.description: Execution of known offensive tools or encoded PowerShell/cmd patterns on endpoint.
defense_recommendations: Block execution of known offensive binaries
Isolate host on critical process match

techniques.name: Brute Force Authentication
techniques.description: Repeated failed authentication attempts indicating credential brute force.
defense_recommendations: Implement account lockout after N failures
Enable MFA on all remote access
Block source IP after threshold failures

techniques.name: Known Malware Hash
techniques.description: File hash matches known malicious indicator in threat intelligence database.
